while true; do
  # Check if download process is still running
  status=$(ssh connect.westd.seetacloud.com "ps -p 3865 -o pid= 2>/dev/null && echo RUNNING || echo DONE" 2>/dev/null)

    echo "DOWNLOAD COMPLETE. Log tail: $result"

    echo "Model dir: $model_info"
    break
  fi
  
  # Still running - get progress
  progress=$(ssh connect.westd.seetacloud.com "du -sh /root/autodl-tmp/models/._____temp/Qwen/Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct/ 2>/dev/null; tail -1 /tmp/model_download.log 2>/dev/null | tr -d '\r' | sed 's/.*\(Downloading.*\)/\1/' | tail -1" 2>/dev/null)
  echo "Progress: $progress"
  
  sleep 300
done
